voice

abstract.text: All migration steps necessary in reading apps to upgrade to major versions of the Swift Readium toolkit will be documented in this file.
The Readium Swift toolkit enables you to develop reading apps for iOS and iPadOS. It provides built-in support for multiple publication formats such as EPUB, PDF, audiobooks, and comics.

The Timeline API lays out the table of contents of a publication on its reading order. It answers questions such as “which chapter am I in?”, “what is the next chapter?” or “how much is left in this chapter?”. Use it to show where each chapter starts in a table of contents, to display the current chapter in a running header, to step through the chapters of a publication, or to pause the playback at the end of an audiobook chapter.
The Search API lets you look for a textual query in the content of a
. EPUB and PDF publications are supported.
